posts.title: Acne Problems During My Teenage Years
posts.description: Hi, girlies! Or anyone else who has been struggling with acne like I have. I wouldn't consider my acne to be a severe case, but I would say it's mild and persistent. I've been dealing with it ever since I hit puberty. It first started appearing around the time I got my first period, and ever since then, it has continued to come and go.
